title: Pandora Hearts
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At his coming-of-age ceremony, noble heir Oz Vessalius is condemned by the red-cloaked Baskervilles for 'the sin of being alive' and cast into the Abyss. He escapes by contracting with the Chain Alice, finds ten years have passed, and joins the organization Pandora to uncover the truth behind a century-old catastrophe.
life_message: A good life means choosing your own meaning and loyalties even when your existence is called a mistake.
